name.baseName: Fluosilicic acid, 22% in H2O, at plant

dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: The process describes the production of phosphoric acid from dry phosphate rock with the dyhydrate process in Morocco. As products of the multi output process fertiliser grade phosphoric acid (impure with 51% P2O5) and dilute fluosilic acid (22% in H2O) was considered.; UUID: 28ab68a2-4a2a-3deb-9595-dd31a7ac1e35

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Data for amount of phosphoric acid production from statisitcs of IFA (International Fertiliser Agency). Data on phosphoric acid process from a report concerning one production in Morocco and from different literature sources and studies concerning also other locations other than Morocco (mainly U.S., Florida). Most data asessed for processes used in the Safi-plant were extrapolated for the whole Moroccan production. Only production from dry rock considered as in the mayority of the sites in Morocco used. Data for production of fluosilic acid from one european study (EFMA). This data was was used for the whole Moroccan production.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Data refers to wet-phosphoric acid production from dry phosphate rock by the dihydrate process. Technology with sea water once-through cooling and gypsum disposal to the ocean considered.

# Included processes
Raw materials, processing chemicals and processing energy, direct emissions to air from process, emissions to air and water from phosphogypsum disposal, emission of radioactive substances from gypsum to air and water, transport of raw materials to the plant, estimation for process infrastructure. The process includes data on emissions from phosphogypsum disposal to the ocean.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: Production of phosphoric acid assessed mainly with data from one site in Morocco (capacity about 1.3 Mt P2O5 per year). It was was assumed that the data cover about 30-50% of the Moroccan production. The total amount of fluosilic acid produced is not known. The production was assessed with weak data from one source. Therefore no representativity of the data can be given for fluosilic acid production.
